title: LLV-GBANK-LOGELASTIC: paid basis-bank interpreter with a strict source reduction

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE physical LLV-GBANK-LOGELASTIC interpreter in proof.md executes the complete scoped GPS-LOGELASTIC program in virtual.md with fixed selected beta=1/8,eta=1,gamma=-15/16. It recovers the entire secret from independent ideal copies with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. For n<2^4096 it uses the explicit exhaustive finite branch; otherwise v=ceil(sqrt n), ell=ceil(log2n), h=ceil(ell^(1/8)), b=v*(ell+2h-16), m=ceil((n-1)/b), with all source/decoder/precision and acquisition/fallback quantities recomputed. Jointly on EVERY branch, including failed work, discarded copies, wrong labels, both aborts, padded bank growth, source moves and output-first cleanup, paid time T is O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n)*log2n+sqrt(n)*(log2n)^(1/8))) with exact growth index1/2. Absolute constants are independent of N,s and outcomes. The CQ simulation preserves the whole output law and source-request sequence, while the stronger internal 4sqrt(n) margin pays all polynomial interpreter work. All basis/coherent/padded/source-moving wires, allocator/controller metadata, full addressing, initialization and cleanup count. Current physical memory columns are not mixed with V allocations. All resources and clean fraction0 concern this same configuration.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK-LOGELASTIC algorithm/configuration, the guaranteed malformed-source fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. For every N>=2 and every secret, all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states and full-secret recovery succeeds with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 jointly with all four physical resource bounds. The bank simulation preserves the complete output and source law under this promise. Additional bank measurements may expose classical record bits under a different adaptive supplier model, for which no transfer or positive tolerance is claimed. Zero is not an impossibility assertion about greater robustness.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
